verdict: A slow week on leads; six overdue items now directly limit your growth.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads at a cost of $215.59 each — up 33% from the prior week — while Instagram reach dropped sharply, signaling that the current ad creative has run its course and is being refreshed now. More critically, six planned milestones are overdue by 18 days or more: the booking bot, intake owner, Review Boost campaign, financing page, Homer Glen branch page, and heating LSA re-enable are all unresolved, and those gaps are the primary ceiling on volume right now. On the organic side, your Quality HVAC Solutions profile generated 27 calls and 70 direction requests this period, carrying the bulk of your Google Business engagement while the other two profiles remain underperforming. Clearing the overdue milestones — particularly the intake owner role and the LSA heating re-enable — is the single highest-leverage move heading into fall heating season.
